newsitem.title: ITALY: IBCA confirms A long debt rating for Cassa Firenze.
newsitem.headline: IBCA confirms A long debt rating for Cassa Firenze.

text.p: European rating agency IBCA said that it had confirmed its "A" rating on Cassa di Risparmio di Firenze long term debt and its "A1" rating on short term debt.

The bank said in a statement that the IBCA had said that the Cassa di Risparmio di Firenze had strong deposits and loans in the Tuscany region of Italy, which in 1995 and the first half of 1996 had given a good net margin of interest and a return on equity that was above the average in Italian banking.
The IBCA concluded that the bank was well capitalised and had good liquidity, the bank statement said.
